name: Gurobura ~Grow up Bride~
source:
Main character is director of a super-large company. He aims to become president, but father denies this possibility till son finds a wife. But it's difficult to find a suitable woman with high ideals, so protagonist decides to raise an ideal bride himself.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-february-2006-muv-luv.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一家超大型企业的董事。他希望成为总裁，父亲却表示，在儿子找到妻子之前绝不会同意。主人公择偶标准极高，很难找到合适的女性，于是决定亲自培养一名理想新娘。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-february-2006-muv-luv.html]vndbreview[/url]]
